name: ODAILY
expansion: Our Daily table – home cooking, explained
tagline: Everyday home cooking explained: knife skills, weeknight dinners, meal planning, baking and the kitchen science behind them
description: ODAILY is a calm, practical guide to everyday home cooking: kitchen basics, quick weeknight dinners, meal prep and planning, reliable baking, the science of what happens in the pan, and how to stock and store a pantry without waste.
author: ODAILY Kitchen Team

categories.name: Kitchen Basics
categories.description: Knife skills, heat control, seasoning, reading a recipe and the handful of techniques that make every other dish easier.

categories.name: Weeknight Cooking
categories.description: Dinners on the table in thirty to forty minutes: one-pan meals, pasta, stir-fries, soups and eggs, with ingredients you can actually find.

categories.name: Meal Prep & Planning
categories.description: Plan a week of meals, shop with a list, cook once and eat twice, pack lunches and feed a family on a sensible budget.

categories.name: Baking
categories.description: Bread, biscuits, cakes and pastry without guesswork: measuring, mixing, proofing, oven temperatures and fixing what went wrong.

categories.name: Kitchen Science
categories.description: Why onions brown, why bread rises, why salt matters and why sauces split: the chemistry and physics behind good cooking.

categories.name: Pantry & Storage
categories.description: Stock a useful pantry, read dates, store food safely in the fridge and freezer, use leftovers and throw less away.
